title: DynaMag
description:
The DynaMag is a strong magnet and can be attached to metal surfaces. This gives you a location to sit your vapcap while cooling. This magnet can also be used to remove the hot cap for faster cooling and repacking of your vapcap.
Included
1 x DynaMag Magnet
